reason: Named end-of-season judgements of six seasonal staff of Les Voyageurs de la Verendrye, private individuals in their late teens and early twenties in 1963. One is named as the season's single exception to a staff otherwise judged adequate; another has his temperament discussed at length. Two elements of the same section are institutional rather than personal and are carried unembargoed in f_5053: the camp deliberately testing bush skills against youth-work experience as a hiring principle, and its use of an attitude scale of counsellor prediction attributed to Dr. Dimock.

reason: A sustained personal criticism of Kanawana's caretaker for the 1973 season -- contempt, unfriendliness, petty harassment, and an implied theory of the man's attitude to work. The report names the post, not the person, which makes him recoverable from any staff roster or payroll list of that season and the passage therefore an identification by inference. Publishing it would attach a fifty-year-old character judgement to whichever name that turns out to be. The institutional content of the same passage -- that Voyageur presence at Kanawana produced friction, and that the Voyageurs asked only for showers and access to buildings -- is carried unembargoed in f_5055.
